answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybil farms: each identity's rewards sit in a locked vault and release only over 30 epochs, while any later finding that the account was a duplicate claws back the unvested balance. A fresh identity is no tax haven; its nectar ripens slowly, like a meadow that must be tended season after season. An attacker running 1,000 fakes must keep each one doing verified work for months, paying compute the whole time, yet can lose everything to a single detection.
